Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of gv, ivp, and lightspeed-venture-partners.

providers.name: BillionToOne
providers.description: BillionToOne is a molecular diagnostics company using proprietary single-molecule Quantitative Counting Template (QCT) technology to detect disease at the DNA level from cell-free DNA. Its Unity prenatal screening suite (Unity Complete, Unity Confirm, and Unity fetal antigen tests) delivers non-invasive prenatal testing from maternal blood at nine weeks, and its Northstar oncology line (Northstar Select and Northstar Response) provides liquid-biopsy therapy selection and real-time treatment-response monitoring. BillionToOne integrates with electronic medical records through a collaboration with Epic and delivers results through its provider and patient portals. It was added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of 500 Global, Norwest Venture Partners, and Y Combinator.

providers.name: ConnectRN
providers.description: connectRN is a Waltham, Massachusetts based per-diem (PRN) healthcare staffing marketplace that connects nurses, CNAs and allied clinicians with open shifts at hospitals, home health and hospice agencies, and skilled nursing facilities across the United States. Clinicians browse and claim shifts through the connectRN mobile app with no minimum commitment, no required weekends or holidays, and same-day pay; facilities post shifts, auto-backfill open coverage and approve timesheets through a web platform at app.connectrn.com. In April 2026 connectRN merged with SnapCare, combining connectRN's PRN clinician community with SnapCare's Booker workforce technology platform. connectRN operates a public status page but publishes no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract; its API host api.connectrn.com serves the first-party mobile and web applications only.

providers.name: Grow Therapy
providers.description: Grow Therapy is a mental-health platform that connects individuals with licensed therapists and prescribers, offering virtual and in-person talk therapy plus medication management in one insurance-integrated experience. The company operates a two-sided marketplace: a client-facing product for finding, booking, and paying for care (with insurance verification and an average session cost around $21 for covered clients) and a provider portal that gives clinicians scheduling, billing, telehealth, and practice-management tooling. Grow also partners with employers, physicians, and payors on B2B mental-health access. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of Menlo Ventures and added to the API Evangelist network; Grow Therapy publishes a public Statuspage but does not expose a public developer API, so this profile captures its company identity, operational transparency, and domain-security posture rather than API artifacts.

providers.name: Hello Heart
providers.description: Hello Heart is a digital health company that combines a mobile app, connected blood-pressure monitors, a smart pill box, and the Nia AI assistant (trained on ACC/AHA guidelines) to help people proactively manage cardiovascular health. Sold primarily to employers, health plans, unions, and public-sector benefits programs as a covered heart-health benefit, the platform pairs self-monitoring with clinically-grounded, "safe AI" coaching to lower blood pressure and reduce cardiac risk. Hello Heart is HITRUST CSF certified, SOC 2 Type 2 audited, NIST CSF aligned, and HIPAA compliant, with data encrypted in transit and at rest and stored within U.S. borders. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's public identity, security, and compliance posture.

providers.name: Naluri
providers.description: Naluri is a digital health and corporate wellness platform operating across Southeast Asia. It delivers Employee Assistance Programmes, chronic disease management (mental health, obesity, diabetes, hypertension, and cholesterol), health coaching and consultations, performance workshops, and Mental Health First Aid training for employers, insurers, and individuals. The company reports serving over one million members and 200-plus companies, and states it is certified for HIPAA, GDPR, and ISO/IEC 27001. No public developer portal, API documentation, or API surface is published as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Ophelia Health
providers.description: Ophelia is a telehealth company providing private, evidence-based medication-assisted treatment (MAT) for opioid use disorder from home. Founded in 2019 by Zack Gray and Mattan Griffel and headquartered in New York City, Ophelia connects patients with licensed clinicians for video visits, prescribes Suboxone (buprenorphine + naloxone) sent to a local pharmacy, and provides ongoing care-team support seven days a week. The subscription service accepts most major insurance plans, including Medicaid, and is licensed to provide care across 49 states and Washington, D.C. Ophelia is a direct-to-consumer clinical service and does not publish a public developer API, SDK, or partner API program; this profile captures its public web presence and domain security posture.

providers.name: Ordr
providers.description: Ordr provides AI-powered security for connected devices, delivering a Cyber Asset Attack Surface Management (CAASM) platform that discovers, classifies, and secures IT, IoT, OT, and IoMT devices across enterprise networks. The platform combines device intelligence, risk and vulnerability management, network segmentation, and zero-trust enforcement to move organizations from visibility to action. Ordr integrates with existing security and networking infrastructure (Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Fortinet, Aruba, Juniper) and serves healthcare, manufacturing, financial services, government, and retail sectors. The company is headquartered in Santa Clara, California. This profile was surfaced as a portfolio company of Battery Ventures and enriched from Ordr's public web surface; Ordr does not publish a public developer API or developer portal.

providers.name: Physiohome
providers.description: Physiohome, operating as Ameen (رعاية أمين), is a Saudi Arabia-based, tech-enabled provider of home rehabilitation and physical therapy services. Founded in 2021 out of a Ministry of Health sector accelerator, the company delivers physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, nutritional therapy, and personal training for adults and seniors in patients' homes and rehabilitation centers. Its platform manages the full care journey from assessment and treatment planning through session tracking, provider equipping, and reporting, with 100+ active service providers operating across nine cities and a wider network of 700+ providers. Ameen offers iOS and Android apps, an online booking flow, and a patient portal, but publishes no public developer API, documentation, or developer portal. It is a portfolio company of Sanabil 500 (500 Global) and Saudi Venture Capital.

providers.name: Power
providers.description: Power (withpower.com) is a clinical-trial search and matching platform that helps patients find and enroll in research studies. It maintains a database of tens of thousands of active clinical trials searchable by condition, location, and drug type, and connects patients, providers, research coordinators, and trial sponsors. Added to the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company of Anthemis and CRV; no public API surface was found during enrichment.

providers.name: Radical Health
providers.description: Radical Health is a Khosla Ventures-backed healthcare AI company that produces personalized, expert-reviewed cancer treatment reports for patients in the United States. Its platform ingests a patient's medical records and synthesizes oncology research, clinical trials, and prior patient outcomes into a tailored report within days, drawing on 5.3 million research papers, 11.8 million patient journeys, 20,000 treatment options, and 48,800+ active US clinical trials. The service pairs an always-on AI nurse navigator ("Alice") with human oncology oversight from institutions including UCLA, Johns Hopkins, Stanford, and Kaiser Permanente, and connects to 70,000+ US healthcare institutions (Epic, Kaiser, Ascension, HCA, Medicare) for records access. Reports are informational and educational only, not medical advice. Radical Health is HIPAA and SOC 2 Type II certified and operates as a consumer subscription product ($110/month with a 7-day free trial); it does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Seer
providers.description: Seer, Inc. (NASDAQ: SEER) is a Redwood City, California life-sciences company pioneering proteomics, the large-scale study of proteins. Its Proteograph Product Suite pairs engineered nanoparticles with automated sample preparation and mass spectrometry to profile tens of thousands of proteins across biological samples at scale, and its cloud-based Proteograph Analysis System (PAS) software processes and interprets the resulting proteomic data for pharmaceutical, biopharma, and academic research. Seer exposes no public developer API; its software surface is the login-gated PAS platform delivered to customers of the Proteograph suite.

providers.name: sophiagenetics
providers.description: SOPHiA GENETICS (NASDAQ SOPH) is a healthcare technology company democratizing data-driven medicine through its cloud-based SOPHiA DDM Platform, which analyzes genomic, radiomic, and multimodal data to support clinicians and researchers across oncology, hereditary disorders, rare diseases, and precision medicine. The platform spans SOPHiA DDM for Genomics, Multimodal, and Radiomics, plus Alamut Visual Plus for variant interpretation and the OncoPortal knowledge base. The product is delivered as a login-gated SaaS platform; no public developer API or portal is currently published.

providers.name: Actium Health
providers.description: ActiumHealth is the conversational AI platform for healthcare patient communication, operated as a division of Syllable Corporation. Its voice, SMS, chat and email agents automate inbound and outbound patient calls across appointment scheduling, prescription refill, call routing, referral management, patient surveys, care coordination and revenue cycle workflows for health systems, patient access centers, healthcare contact centers and practice groups, with more than 70 million calls reported handled. The agents integrate with Epic, Cerner and Meditech EHRs through those vendors' APIs, and the platform is marketed as built to SOC 2, HITRUST and HIPAA standards. ActiumHealth consumes EHR APIs rather than publishing one and runs no developer program on actiumhealth.com; the underlying agentic platform API, SDKs, CLI, MCP server and documentation are published by its parent at syllable.ai and catalogued here as `syllable`.

providers.name: Cardinal Health
providers.description: Cardinal Health is a Fortune 15 global integrated healthcare services and products company that provides pharmaceutical distribution, medical-surgical product distribution, and customized solutions for hospitals, health systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, and physician offices. Cardinal Health does not publish a public developer portal, but it exchanges high volumes of B2B trading data with customers and suppliers via standard X12 EDI transactions (850, 810, 855, 856, 846, 832, 867) over AS2, SFTP, and private API channels. Third-party EDI platforms such as Orderful, Crossfire, SPS Commerce, Zenbridge, DataTrans, Alluvia, ConnectPointz, and Spark Shipping offer managed connectors into Cardinal Health for order-to-cash, inventory, and supply-chain automation.

providers.name: HealthEngine
providers.description: HealthEngine is Australia's largest consumer healthcare marketplace and patient-engagement platform, founded in 2006 and headquartered in Perth, Western Australia. Its consumer app and website let millions of Australians search a national directory of primary-care providers and book, manage, and attend appointments (including telehealth) across GP, dental, allied-health, and specialist practices. For practices, HealthEngine sells a SaaS suite - GP Complete, Patient Connect, Online Booking, Appointment Reminders and Recalls, Featured Listings, online payments, patient reviews, and Scripts - that plugs into the practice's existing software. It maintains private, real-time integrations into 25+ Australian practice management systems (Best Practice / Bp Premier, MedicalDirector Pracsoft, Zedmed, Cliniko, Genie, Gentu, Medtech, Nookal, PracSuite, Dental4Windows, and others) so appointment availability and bookings sync directly with the front desk. Home market is Australia. HealthEngine does NOT publish a public developer portal, REST OpenAPI, or HL7 FHIR endpoint - its API surface is a set of gated, partner-only PMS integrations rather than a self-serve developer program, so this profile is an honest identity stub with no public machine-readable contract to harvest.

providers.name: Irhythmtech
providers.description: iRhythm Technologies is a publicly traded (NASDAQ: IRTC) digital healthcare company specializing in ambulatory cardiac monitoring for the detection and management of heart arrhythmias. Its Zio service pairs a wearable single-lead ECG biosensor patch (Zio monitor and Zio AT) with FDA-cleared AI/deep-learning algorithms, qualified cardiac technician verification, and cloud-based data analytics to produce end-of-wear diagnostic reports for clinicians. The platform includes the ZioSuite clinician portal for report interpretation and patient management, the MyZio patient app for symptom logging and education, EHR integration, and telehealth workflows. iRhythm was surfaced as a portfolio company of Norwest Venture Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. It does not publish a public developer API or documentation portal; enrichment is limited to public identity, trust, and domain-security signals.

providers.name: Pluto
providers.description: Pluto (Pluto Health, trypluto.com now pluto.health) is an AI-powered clinical intelligence and care-delivery platform that unifies fragmented health data from roughly 90% of US health systems. It aggregates medical records, insurance data, and social determinants of health, then applies AI-driven clinical intelligence to surface care gaps, coordinate preventive care, screenings, vaccines and at-home lab testing, and match patients to clinical trials. Pluto offers turnkey, white-label, or API-based deployment of its clinical operations. It is backed by Sierra Ventures. As of this enrichment pass the company publishes no public developer portal, API reference, SDKs, or documentation.

providers.name: TMRW Life Sciences *
providers.description: TMRW Life Sciences is a medical technology company that builds the world's first and only FDA-cleared automated platform for the safe management and storage of frozen eggs and embryos used in IVF and fertility treatment. Its cryo-storage hardware combines robotic specimen handling with digital tracking, chain-of-custody monitoring, and real-time visibility for fertility clinics and their patients, replacing manual, paper-based handling of irreplaceable reproductive tissue. Deployed at clinic networks including CCRM Fertility, Pinnacle Fertility, RFC, and IVIRMA North America. TMRW is a private company backed by GV (Google Ventures). It publishes a Security & Trust program (SOC 2 Type 2, ISO 27001, ISO 27018) but does not expose a public developer portal, API, or specification surface.

providers.name: ExaCare AI
providers.description: ExaCare AI is a post-acute and senior care operations platform that applies AI to admissions, referral management, prior authorization, and reimbursement workflows across skilled nursing, home health, hospice, and assisted living providers. It reads inbound referral and admissions packets, extracts clinical and payer data, and automates the back-office work of accepting and reimbursing patients, with integrations into referral platforms, hospital systems, and EHRs. ExaCare is a private company backed by Insight Partners; it ships a customer web application and a Vanta-hosted Trust Center (HIPAA) but publishes no public developer API at this time.

providers.name: Faks
providers.description: Faks is a French SaaS platform that digitizes and streamlines the commercial relationships across the pharmacy ecosystem. It gives pharmacies, pharmacy groups (groupements), and laboratories a single place to manage supplier relationships, commercial claims and disputes (litiges), expired and returnable product handling, promotions, and sell-in / sell-out performance. Faks connects to pharmacy management systems (LGO), purchasing platforms, and accounting tools through its Konnect integrations to automate what has traditionally been manual, paper, and email-driven work between the ~18,000 pharmacies, ~100 groups, and ~500 laboratories it targets in France. The company is backed by Seedcamp. Faks does not currently publish a public developer API, OpenAPI, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the enrichment surfaces that could be probed.

providers.name: medigami-com
providers.description: Medigami is a health technology company focused on providing innovative medical imaging solutions and data analytics platforms for healthcare providers. The company offers a suite of APIs that enable integration of imaging data, patient records, and analytics dashboards, facilitating streamlined workflows and improved diagnostic accuracy. Medigami’s services aim to enhance interoperability across radiology systems, support AI-driven image analysis, and deliver secure, compliant data exchange for hospitals and clinics.

providers.name: Tia
providers.description: Tia is a women's healthcare company that operates in-person clinics and a virtual care platform, bringing primary care, gynecology, mental health, and wellness services into one connected care experience. Founded in 2017 and backed by Canaan Partners, Tia runs clinics in New York, Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Phoenix, offers virtual visits across multiple states, and partners with health systems. Tia is a consumer healthcare provider and does not publish a public developer portal, API documentation, or client SDKs.

providers.name: Tilda Research
providers.description: Tilda Research deploys AI Teammates that perform the operational work of clinical trials for sponsors, CROs, and research sites — automating study workflows, data capture, trial monitoring, and regulatory compliance. Founded by Ram Yalamanchili and backed by 8VC, the company operates the Tilda Sense clinical-research platform (sense.tilda.bio) and advertises SOC 2 and HIPAA compliance via a Vanta-hosted trust center, but publishes no public developer program or API documentation.

providers.name: Vega Health
providers.description: Vega Health is a Durham, North Carolina healthcare AI company founded by Dr. Mark Sendak, formerly of the Duke Institute for Health Innovation. Its platform installs in a health system's own environment (cloud or on-prem) to integrate, evaluate, monitor, and scale clinical AI solutions, alongside a curated marketplace of vetted health AI solutions and commercialization support for academic AI research. Launched October 2025 with a $4M seed round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company publishes a SafeBase trust center (SOC 2, HIPAA) but no public API, developer portal, or SDKs as of 2026-07-21.

providers.name: Backpack Healthcare
providers.description: Backpack Healthcare is a virtual (telehealth) pediatric and family mental health provider delivering therapy, psychiatry, and medication management for children, tweens, teens, young adults, and adults. It offers age-based care (Littles 4-10, Tweens & Teens 11-17, Young Adults 18+, and Adults) across concerns including ADHD, anxiety, autism spectrum disorder, depression, OCD, maternal mental health, and substance use, alongside a consumer Self Care / Care Companion mobile app. Backpack partners with health plans, schools, health systems, and community and government agencies to expand access to youth behavioral health, and is a Techstars portfolio company. It currently exposes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Calibrate
providers.description: Calibrate is a telehealth metabolic-health and weight-loss company that pairs clinician-prescribed GLP-1 medications with 1:1 video coaching and a science-backed educational curriculum to help members improve metabolic health and achieve sustainable weight loss. Programs are sold directly to individuals (from $199/month) and through employer benefits. Calibrate delivers its service through consumer web and iOS mobile apps rather than a public developer API; this profile tracks the company's public web and account surface. Backed by Threshold Ventures.

providers.name: Carepatron
providers.description: Carepatron is a cloud-based healthcare practice management and EHR platform for therapists, counselors, psychologists, health coaches, nutritionists, and other practitioners. It brings client records, appointment scheduling and online booking, telehealth, AI-assisted clinical notes and documentation, and billing/invoicing with insurance claims into one workspace, and markets HIPAA/SOC/GDPR compliance across 100,000+ clinicians in 120+ countries. As of this review Carepatron does NOT publish a documented public developer API - its pricing page lists "API (coming soon)" on the Advanced plan, and there is no developer portal, API reference, published base URL, OpenAPI definition, or SDK. Third-party connectivity today is limited to a handful of native integrations (Zoom, accounting software, Google Tag Manager). The APIs listed below are logical/product-area groupings modeled from Carepatron's own feature set; their endpoints are NOT documented and are marked as modeled, not confirmed.

providers.name: Cherry
providers.description: Cherry is a fintech platform providing point-of-sale patient financing for healthcare and elective-services providers across dental, medical aesthetics, plastic surgery, dermatology, veterinary, and other verticals. Rather than lending directly, Cherry facilitates consumer payment plans through partner lenders, offering Pay-in-4 and longer-term monthly plans (0-35.99% APR), a 60-second application with no hard credit check, upfront provider payout within 2-3 business days, and card-processing services. Cherry states it serves over 60,000 healthcare providers with an approximately 90% approval rate. Cherry is a portfolio company of DCM Ventures. Cherry does not publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI at this time; this profile captures its public identity and security posture.

providers.name: Clearsense
providers.description: Clearsense provides an enterprise healthcare data platform that enables organizations to unify, archive, and manage large volumes of clinical and operational data. Their solutions include data archiving, managed services, and research acceleration tools, helping healthcare providers improve cost savings, revenue recovery, and data accessibility across multiple systems. The company serves hundreds of hospitals and health systems, offering cloud‑native, scalable platforms for data integration, analytics, and compliance.

providers.name: Distyl
providers.description: Distyl is an applied-AI company architecting the AI-native enterprise. Rather than layering automation onto broken processes, Distyl reimagines enterprise operations from the ground up with AI at the core, partnering with Fortune 500 organizations across Telecom, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Insurance, Retail, and Financial Services to design and operationalize AI transformations and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems in weeks. Its product suite includes Weave, Distillery, Context Mesh, Context Views, Journey, Personalization, and Apprentice. Founded by operators and researchers from Palantir, CIA, OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Tesla, NASA, Stanford, and MIT, and backed by Coatue, OpenAI, Lightspeed, Microsoft, and Khosla Ventures. Distyl is a services/platform company with no public developer API; this profile captures its published web surface. Distyl is SOC 2 certified and GDPR compliant.

providers.name: Pear Suite
providers.description: Pear Suite is a care management platform built for community health workers, care navigators, doulas, and community-based organizations, describing itself as an operating system for community-based work. The platform provides custom assessments and care pathways, goal and outcome tracking, patient communication over phone, SMS, and encrypted email, client and population-level analytics, and billing and claims integration, connecting community health initiatives with health plans and health systems. Pear Suite reports serving 2,500+ community workers across 300+ organizations nationwide.

providers.name: Roger
providers.description: Roger (operated by Sanos Services GmbH, Berlin, Germany) is a B2B SaaS practice-management platform for dental clinics. It layers automation and AI onto existing German dental practice-management systems (PVS) such as CGM Z1, Charly, Dampsoft, Evident and Dento Office, adding patient recall, digital intake forms, WhatsApp/SMS communication, AI-assisted documentation with billing-position capture, digital treatment-plan signing, factoring with default protection and instant payout, and outsourced ZMV/reception staffing. The product is DSGVO/GDPR-compliant and hosted in Germany. As surfaced in the API Evangelist network via VC-portfolio discovery, Roger publishes a marketing and product site but no public developer portal, API documentation, or machine-readable API surface at this time.

providers.name: Terapify
providers.description: Terapify is an online therapy platform for the Spanish-speaking market, connecting individuals in Mexico and Latin America with certified psychologists for private, secure video-call sessions. Founded in 2019 and backed by 500 Global and Y Combinator, the platform matches patients to therapists via a therapeutic-affinity test, offers individual and couples therapy, parent orientation, and workplace mental-health programs for companies, plus mindfulness, yoga, and breathing resources. It operates as a consumer web and mobile (iOS/Android) product and publishes no public developer API surface.

providers.name: Apricot
providers.description: Apricot is an AI-native clinical documentation platform for home health and post-acute care agencies, founded by home-health operator Trent Smith and headquartered in Oklahoma. Its software cuts start-of-care (SOC) and OASIS documentation time by up to 85% and QA time by up to 40%, automating medication reconciliation, wound documentation, ICD coding recommendations, and narrative generation while capturing vitals, photos, signatures, and voice notes in the home and syncing to each agency's EMR configuration. Apricot is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant and raised a Series A led by Insight Partners in 2025. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public web presence; Apricot currently publishes no public API, developer portal, or SDKs.

providers.name: bttn
providers.description: bttn (bttn Inc., trading online as bttnusa.com) is a Seattle, Washington based business-to-business e-commerce marketplace and wholesale distributor of medical supplies, lab equipment and pharmaceuticals, selling name-brand consumables to clinics, dental, veterinary and physical-therapy practices, clinical laboratories, home-healthcare providers and other healthcare buyers across the United States. Founded in 2021 by JT Garwood and Jack Miller and backed by Tiger Global, the company operates a self-serve online storefront carrying 60,000+ catalog products with bulk and volume pricing, same- or next-business-day shipping, quote requests, purchase-order and invoice payment, shopping lists, quick-order pads and recurring reorder tooling. The storefront is a BigCommerce commerce back end fronted by a Catalyst/Next.js application. bttn publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable API contract; its e-commerce surface is buyer-facing only.

providers.name: Dental Monitoring
providers.description: Dental Monitoring provides AI-powered dental monitoring solutions that enable remote orthodontic care, allowing clinicians to track patient progress through a patented scanning device and cloud platform. The company offers a suite of tools for dentists and orthodontists to monitor treatment, engage patients, and integrate data into practice workflows, supporting multiple languages and regulatory compliance.

providers.name: FitOn
providers.description: FitOn is a consumer digital fitness and wellness platform offering free, on-demand workout classes (cardio, strength, yoga, Pilates, HIIT), guided meditation, personalized meal plans and nutrition tracking, recipes, and social challenges. FitOn serves 15 million+ members with celebrity and world-class trainers across mobile, web, and connected-TV apps (Apple TV, Roku, Chromecast, Fire TV). Its FitOn Health arm delivers an enterprise wellness benefit to employers, health plans, and brokers. FitOn is backed by Accel. As of this enrichment pass FitOn publishes no public developer API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI; consumer and B2B integration is handled through partnership programs rather than a self-serve API.

providers.name: GetHarley
providers.description: GetHarley is a UK-based telehealth and skincare platform delivering personalised, medical-grade skincare through online consultations. Patients answer questions about their skin concerns, book a video consultation, and are matched with one of a network of over 1,000 licensed dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, and plastic surgeons, who recommend a tailored regimen of medical-grade products delivered to the patient. GetHarley operates both a patient-facing storefront and a practitioner platform used by clinicians to manage recommendations, orders, and client relationships. Backed by Index Ventures, the company addresses concerns such as acne, fine lines, pigmentation, and ageing. As of this profile, GetHarley does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or an MCP server; this record captures its identity, web properties, and probed domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Neurelis
providers.description: Neurelis, Inc. is a privately held San Diego neuroscience and specialty pharmaceutical company founded in 2007 that licenses, develops and commercializes therapies for epilepsy, psychiatry and other central nervous system disorders with high unmet need. Its lead commercial product is VALTOCO (diazepam nasal spray), an FDA-approved acute treatment for intermittent, stereotypic episodes of frequent seizure activity (seizure clusters) in adult and pediatric patients two years of age and older, built on Intravail transmucosal absorption-enhancement technology acquired with Aegis Therapeutics. Neurelis also holds the ProTek and Hydrogel drug-delivery platforms, licenses Intravail to partners such as ARS Pharmaceuticals and Dr. Reddy's/Upsher-Smith, and is advancing the NRL-1049 and NRL-1004 pipeline programs. Neurelis publishes no developer program, no public API and no machine-readable API contract; its only agent-facing machine-readable surface is a set of llms.txt documents served on its corporate, product and patient-support properties.

providers.name: Octave Bioscience
providers.description: Octave Bioscience is a precision neurology company founded in 2014 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, that develops blood-based multi-protein biomarker tests for chronic neurological disease. Its commercially available Octave Multiple Sclerosis Disease Activity (MSDA) Test measures a panel of serum proteins to produce a quantitative disease activity score used alongside clinical and imaging assessment, and is available across the United States through a strategic collaboration with Quest Diagnostics. The company is also developing a Multiple Sclerosis Disease Progression (MSDP) test and a Parkinson's disease biomarker assay supported by a Michael J. Fox Foundation grant. Octave publishes a public trust center documenting HITRUST, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001:2023, HIPAA and GDPR posture, but operates no public developer program, API reference, SDK or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: ScreenPoint Medical
providers.description: ScreenPoint Medical is a Netherlands-based healthcare AI company, founded in 2014 by Professor Nico Karssemeijer and Professor Sir Michael Brady, that develops Transpara Breast AI for earlier detection of breast cancer in 2D (FFDM) and 3D (DBT) mammography. Transpara is vendor-agnostic, integrates into PACS and reading workflows via medical-imaging (DICOM) pipelines rather than a public developer API, and is FDA cleared (K241831, K232096) and CE marked (0344). The product is used in over 200 clinics across 25+ countries and is backed by three randomized controlled trials (including MASAI in The Lancet). The company is backed by Insight Partners. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline: no public developer/API surface exists, but real security-disclosure and compliance posture were captured.

providers.name: Collective Medical
providers.description: Collective Medical is a full-continuum, real-time care collaboration network for healthcare, connecting hospitals, health systems, post-acute providers, health plans, and payers so care teams can coordinate around complex, high-risk, and vulnerable patients across the entire patient journey. Founded in Utah and backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Kleiner Perkins, the platform is known for its real-time event notifications, ADT-based care-coordination alerts, and shared clinical insights used by emergency departments and care-management teams. Collective Medical was acquired by PointClickCare in 2020 and is now fully integrated into PointClickCare; its former developer, login, support, and legal surfaces are served through PointClickCare properties (developer.pointclickcare.com and pointclickcare.com). This profile tracks the Collective Medical brand within the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Hippocratic AI
providers.description: Hippocratic AI builds safety-focused generative AI agents for non-diagnostic healthcare tasks, powered by its Polaris constellation architecture. Polaris 5.0 is a multi-trillion-parameter constellation of specialized models clinically validated by U.S.-licensed clinicians. Hippocratic AI sells agents such as Nurse Co-Pilot and AI Front Door to health systems, payors, and life-sciences organizations through enterprise sales rather than a self-service public API.

providers.name: Pearly
providers.description: Pearly provides dental practice billing and revenue cycle management automation software. Its platform streamlines patient billing, accounts receivable, payment plans, letter automation, and integrates with practice management systems. Pearly serves DSOs, group practices, and private dental offices, offering online payments, reporting, and AI‑driven insights to improve cash flow and reduce administrative overhead.

providers.name: ShiftMed
providers.description: ShiftMed is a McLean, Virginia healthcare workforce technology company operating an on-demand clinician marketplace and AI-powered open shift management platform for hospitals, health systems, skilled nursing facilities and post-acute providers. It matches credentialed W-2 CNAs, LPNs and RNs to open shifts, and markets an API that lets a facility tap that clinician network directly from its own scheduling stack. The API surface reaches customers through workforce-management partner integrations — UKG Pro Workforce Management (formerly UKG Dimensions), symplr Smart Square, QGenda, Smartlinx and Attendance on Demand — alongside file-based SFTP feeds. ShiftMed publishes no public developer portal, documentation, specification or SDK; API access is arranged through a workforce consultation.

providers.name: Cortico
providers.description: Cortico (Cortico Health Technologies) is a Vancouver, British Columbia based healthcare connection platform, founded in 2019, that links patients, medical clinics, and health records across Canada and the United States. Its patient-engagement suite layers online booking, automated appointment reminders, secure two-way patient messaging, digital intake forms, telemedicine, specialist e-referrals, payments, and AI-driven administrative automation on top of the electronic medical records (EMRs) clinics already run — most notably a supported two-way integration with OSCAR EMR through that system's REST/SOAP web services, plus SMART on FHIR contextual launch and robotic process automation (RPA). Cortico is SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certified and compliant with HIPAA, PIPEDA, and PHIPA. Cortico consumes EMR and FHIR interfaces rather than publishing its own public developer API: as of this review there is no public developer portal, API reference, or FHIR CapabilityStatement, and integration is delivered through a partnership and onboarding model rather than self-serve API access.

providers.name: Everself
providers.description: Bariendo Inc. (now operating as Everself) is a science-forward digital health company pioneering non-surgical, endoscopic weight-loss care. Founded in 2023 by Harvard Medical School physicians Dr. Christopher C. Thompson (the inventor of Endoscopic Sleeve Gastroplasty) and Dr. Pichamol Jirapinyo, the company delivers minimally invasive procedures — ESG Stomach Tightening, gastric balloon, and revision of prior bariatric surgery — alongside weight-loss medication and a 12-month concierge care program. Its consumer platform streamlines access to these interventions across a dozen-plus U.S. locations, with financing, telehealth consultations, and ongoing weight tracking. Bariendo/Everself is a consumer and clinical health service; it publishes no public developer portal, API, or SDK surface.

providers.name: Foresight Diagnostics
providers.description: Foresight Diagnostics is a CLIA-certified, CAP-accredited cancer diagnostics company founded in 2020 in Boulder, Colorado by Stanford physicians and scientists, and since February 2026 a wholly owned subsidiary of Natera. Its Foresight CLARITY minimal residual disease (MRD) platform is a liquid-biopsy test powered by proprietary PhasED-Seq phased-variant sequencing and bioinformatics, detecting circulating tumor DNA at an analytical sensitivity below one part per million across lymphoma, lung and other solid tumors. The company sells laboratory testing services to biopharma sponsors, academic researchers and clinicians rather than software: it operates a central laboratory and publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable specification of any kind.

providers.name: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company
providers.description: Takeda Pharmaceutical Company Limited is a Japanese multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Tokyo, founded in 1781 and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (4502) and the New York Stock Exchange (TAK). It is the largest pharmaceutical company in Japan and Asia, and operates globally across oncology, rare genetic and hematologic diseases, neuroscience, gastroenterology, plasma-derived therapies and vaccines, a portfolio substantially expanded by its 2019 acquisition of Shire. Takeda is a software consumer rather than a software vendor: it runs large internal API and data platforms, but publishes no public developer program, API reference or machine-readable contract. The one machine-readable document it does serve to automated clients is an llms.txt at its corporate root, which indexes its verified country websites and states an explicit LLM usage and attribution policy.

providers.name: Tia Health
providers.description: Tia Health is a Canadian telehealth platform that connects patients with licensed Canadian providers - family doctors, nurse practitioners, specialists, and naturopaths - for on-demand virtual care by phone, video, and secure messaging. Its services span virtual walk-in and family-practice appointments, prescription renewals, sick notes, lab requisitions, and mental health therapy (via partner Focus Mental Wellness), with visits covered by provincial health plans in Ontario (OHIP), British Columbia (MSP), and Alberta (AHCIP) and paid options elsewhere. Tia Health is part of the WELL Health Technologies Corp. clinic network, one of the largest outpatient networks in Canada. As of this review Tia Health is a consumer-facing virtual-care product with no public developer portal, no documented REST/OpenAPI, and no exposed HL7 FHIR CapabilityStatement or SMART-on-FHIR configuration; interoperability in the Canadian market is stewarded federally through Canada Health Infoway's pan-Canadian FHIR (CA Core / CA Baseline) specifications, which this platform does not publicly surface.

providers.name: Axxess
providers.description: Home health, hospice, and private duty software with REST APIs for managing patient plans of care, visit documentation, billing, scheduling, and OASIS assessments. Axxess provides certified EHR technology with FHIR-compliant interoperability, supporting data exchange across care settings via HL7, TEFCA, FHIR, HITRUST, and HIPAA standards.

providers.name: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services
providers.description: Comprehensive Pharmacy Services, now operating as CPS Solutions, LLC, is a healthcare company with more than 50 years of experience providing pharmacy and hospital solutions across the care continuum. It serves independent hospitals, health systems, integrated delivery networks (IDNs), and specialized health facilities with specialty pharmacy, pharmacy management, telepharmacy (24/7/365 support), 340B program compliance, supply chain management, rehabilitation services, and consulting. The company operates two proprietary SaaS platforms — CPS Optimizer for pharmacy management and TherigySTM for specialty pharmacy management — supported by 2,500+ healthcare professionals serving 800+ customers across the United States and Puerto Rico. No public API or developer program is currently published; this profile captures the company identity and public web surface.

providers.name: Activ Surgical
providers.description: Activ Surgical is a Boston, Massachusetts digital surgery company building intraoperative surgical intelligence for the operating room. Its flagship product, the ActivSight Intelligent Light imaging module, attaches to existing laparoscopic and robotic surgical systems and renders augmented-reality overlays on a standard monitor, letting surgeons see physiology the naked eye cannot. ActivPerfusion delivers dye-free, real-time blood-perfusion imaging using laser speckle contrast imaging, while ActivICG supports conventional indocyanine green visualization of structures such as bile ducts. The module is powered by the ActivEdge platform, a hardware-agnostic computer-vision, AI and machine-learning stack the company is building to turn intraoperative data into real-time surgical guidance. Activ Surgical performed the first autonomous robotic soft-tissue surgery in 2018, received FDA 510(k) clearance for ActivSight in April 2021 and CE Mark approval in December 2022, and sells on a subscription model with no capital-equipment purchase. The company publishes no public developer program, API, SDK or machine-readable API contract as of this profiling pass; its public technical surface is regulatory (EU MDR declarations of conformity, ISO 13485:2016) and clinical (peer-reviewed studies and white papers).

providers.name: Aily Labs
providers.description: Aily Labs is a Munich-based enterprise AI company that builds an AI Decision Intelligence Suite — a platform that connects siloed internal and external data to deliver real-time, explainable predictions and recommendations across Finance, R&D, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Quality, Go-To-Market, Procurement, and People functions. The suite ships with 300+ validated predictive models and an iOS app, and is deployed across Healthcare & Life Sciences, Consumer Goods, Luxury & Fashion, Media & Tech, Retail, and Services (clients include Sanofi). Aily Labs is a portfolio company of Insight Partners. It exposes no public developer API; this profile captures the company's corporate, security, and compliance surface.

providers.name: Alzheon
providers.description: Alzheon, Inc. is a privately held clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company founded in 2013 and headquartered at 111 Speen Street, Framingham, Massachusetts, developing oral small-molecule therapeutics and diagnostics for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative disorders. Its lead candidate, valiltramiprosate (ALZ-801) — a valine-conjugated prodrug of tramiprosate that blocks the formation of neurotoxic soluble beta-amyloid oligomers — has FDA Fast Track designation and completed the pivotal APOLLOE4 Phase 3 trial in APOE4/4 homozygotes with early Alzheimer's disease. Alzheon operates no product or developer API and publishes no developer portal, SDKs or API documentation; its corporate site does serve the standard WordPress REST API anonymously, which makes its press releases, science pages and media library machine-readable.

providers.name: Better Life Partners
providers.description: Better Life Partners is a Hanover, New Hampshire healthcare provider founded in 2018 that delivers same-day, whole-person treatment for opioid and alcohol use disorder across New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Vermont and North Carolina. It combines FDA-approved medication for addiction treatment (buprenorphine/Suboxone, naltrexone) with group counseling, peer recovery coaching and mental health care, delivered both virtually and in person, on a non-punitive harm-reduction model. The company contracts directly with Medicaid, Medicare and commercial health plans — MaineCare, NH Healthy Families, Anthem, Cigna, Harvard Pilgrim, Tufts, Humana and UnitedHealthcare — and markets value-based arrangements "from bundles to full risk" to payers and community partners. It is a clinical services organization rather than a software vendor: it references "purpose-built technology" internally but publishes no developer program, API, specification, SDK or integration documentation of any kind.

providers.name: Biobot
providers.description: Biobot Analytics is a wastewater epidemiology company that operates a wastewater intelligence platform, analyzing sewage samples to detect and track more than 50 human health indicators — including pathogens (SARS-CoV-2, influenza, RSV, measles, norovirus), substances (fentanyl, cocaine, methamphetamine, buprenorphine), and public-health threats (HIV, mpox, poliovirus, Candida auris) — before they surface in conventional reporting. Founded from MIT research and headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts, Biobot serves federal, state, and local government agencies, pharmaceutical and life-sciences companies, and healthcare systems through dashboards, CSV exports, map visualizations, and enterprise data integrations. Biobot does not publish a public self-serve developer API; data access is arranged directly with the company.

providers.name: Caresyntax
providers.description: Caresyntax is a surgical intelligence company that builds a vendor-neutral, enterprise-scale data platform for the operating room. Founded in 2013 in Berlin and now dual-headquartered in Berlin and San Francisco, it captures video, audio, image, device, EMR, financial and outcomes data from inside and around the OR and applies AI analytics to it — delivering pre-operative workflow optimization, real-time intraoperative decision support, and post-operative clinical safety, quality and utilization insights. The platform pairs the PRIME365 vendor-neutral OR / medical-device integration layer with the qvident surgical performance-management and analytics suite, and is deployed in more than 4,000 operating rooms worldwide. Caresyntax sells to hospitals and surgery centers, MedTech manufacturers and insurers, and integrates with EMR, PACS and scheduling systems. It operates an API gateway at api.caresyntax.com, but publishes no public developer portal, API documentation, SDKs or machine-readable API contract — integration is delivered through enterprise and partner engagements.

providers.name: Francis Medical
providers.description: Francis Medical is a privately held medical device company headquartered in Maple Grove, Minnesota, founded in 2018 by Michael Hoey and named for his father, who died of prostate cancer in 1991. It develops the Vanquish Water Vapor Ablation System, a transurethral outpatient platform that ablates targeted prostate tissue using the thermal energy stored in sterile water vapor delivered in short bursts through a catheter, with the aim of treating localized disease while avoiding the incontinence and sexual dysfunction associated with radical prostatectomy and radiation. The company received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation in 2023 and 510(k) clearance for prostate tissue ablation in December 2025, and it is running the VAPOR 1 and VAPOR 2 clinical studies alongside a long-term registry; it has signalled intent to extend the same water vapor platform to bladder and kidney cancer. Francis Medical has raised roughly $160 million to date, including an $80 million Series C in January 2025 co-led by Solas BioVentures and Arboretum Ventures, with earlier participation from Coloplast. It is led by president and CEO Mike Kujak. Francis Medical publishes a physician locator, an electronic instructions-for-use (eIFU) library and a coordinated vulnerability disclosure policy for its devices and embedded software, but operates no public developer program, API documentation, or machine-readable API contract.

providers.name: Inovalon
providers.description: Inovalon is a healthcare technology company providing cloud-based data analytics and data-enabled intervention platforms for the healthcare industry. Its Inovalon ONE Platform pairs national-scale primary-source datasets with analytics, workflow, and SaaS applications used by health plans, providers, pharmacies, life-sciences, and specialty organizations for risk adjustment, quality measurement, care-gap closure, and revenue-cycle and claims management (including the ABILITY provider workflow products). Inovalon was surfaced as a portfolio company of Insight Partners and added to the API Evangelist network. Its developer surface is enterprise and auth-gated: the corporate site is WAF-protected and the API host api.inovalon.com requires authentication (HTTP 401); security and compliance posture is published on the public Inovalon Trust Center.

providers.name: Offcall
providers.description: Offcall is a career and practice platform for physicians, backed by Bloomberg Beta. It provides confidential, anonymous physician salary and compensation benchmarking, and a verified clinician-to-clinician patient referrals network with HIPAA-compliant messaging for care coordination, delivered through web and mobile (iOS and Android) applications. Offcall does not currently publish a public developer API, developer portal, or OpenAPI specification; this profile was surfaced through the Bloomberg Beta portfolio and enriched with the identity and domain-security signals that are publicly available.

providers.name: Oscar
providers.description: Oscar Health (NYSE: OSCR) is a technology-driven health insurance company founded in 2012 and headquartered in New York City. It offers individual and family health plans, small-business and ICHRA employer benefits, and Medicare Advantage in a growing set of U.S. states, pairing coverage with a consumer mobile app, 24/7 virtual urgent care, telemedicine, primary care, and concierge Care Teams. Oscar's +Oscar division licenses its full-stack technology platform (Campaign Builder and other tools) to other payers and providers. The company is NCQA-accredited across Health Plan, Utilization Management, Credentialing, Provider Network, and Health Equity programs. Oscar is a General Catalyst portfolio company. As a CMS-regulated payer it is subject to the Interoperability and Patient Access rule, though it does not currently publish an open, self-serve developer API portal.

providers.name: Tasso
providers.description: Tasso, Inc. designs painless, needle-free blood collection devices and an end-to-end logistics platform for decentralized and at-home blood sampling. Its product line includes Tasso+ for capillary whole-blood collection, the Tasso-M20/Mini for dried blood microsampling, and the tile-T20 for liquid serum and plasma, enabling remote specimen collection for clinical trials, patient screening, diagnostics, and research. Tasso pairs the hardware with kitting, shipping, and sample-return logistics and is cited in over 100 peer-reviewed publications. It was surfaced as a Techstars portfolio company and added to the API Evangelist network. No public developer API surface was found at the time of enrichment.

providers.name: 케어그레이드
providers.description: 케어그레이드(케어그레이드)는 국민건강보험공단이 공개한 장기요양기관 평가 데이터를 지역·급여종류별로 비교·제공하는 서비스입니다. 전국 21,213곳의 평가·인력·정원을 한눈에 확인할 수 있으며, 회원가입 없이 무료로 이용할 수 있습니다. 데이터는 공공기관이 제공한 최신 정보를 기반으로 합니다.

providers.name: Artera Decisionrisk Analysis
providers.description: Artera Decisionrisk Analysis, operating as ArteraAI, provides personalized precision medicine and AI-driven cancer therapy solutions. The company offers a multimodal AI platform for clinicians and patients, including diagnostic tests for prostate and breast cancer, and supports HIPAA-compliant data handling. Artera aims to improve outcomes through advanced analytics and regulatory‑approved medical software.

providers.name: Blocks
providers.description: Blocks is an AI‑native training platform for endurance athletes. It lets you build and visualise structured intervals, sync every ride, and train with an assistant that reads your real data – cycling, running, swimming and strength. The service offers a free tier and premium plans, integrates with Strava and intervals.icu, and provides an MCP server for Claude and other AI agents.

providers.name: Fortell
providers.description: Fortell develops clinically proven AI hearing aids that provide superior speech clarity in noisy environments. The company leverages advanced AI algorithms and scientific research to enhance hearing experiences for users, offering personalized solutions and a modern approach to auditory health.

providers.name: National Health Service
providers.description: The National Health Service (NHS) of England publishes a catalogue of APIs for health and care providers, including the Ambulance Data Submission FHIR API used to submit ambulance data to the NHS Data Processing Service (DPS) for analysis and review by NHS England and ambulance trusts.

providers.name: Tigerconnect
providers.description: TigerConnect is a healthcare clinical communication and collaboration (CC&C) platform used by 7,000+ healthcare organizations to unify secure messaging, clinical collaboration, alarm management, physician and nurse scheduling, patient engagement, nurse call, and pre-hospital care-team coordination on one activation layer. It integrates with 200+ medical devices and EHR systems and adds an AI orchestration engine (CareConduit) that routes alerts and workflows to the right clinical role at the right time. TigerConnect is recognized as a leader in the 2025 Gartner Magic Quadrant for Clinical Communications and Collaboration. The company publishes end-user product release notes, an SLA, and legal terms, but exposes no public developer API portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Visby Medical
providers.description: Visby Medical is a molecular diagnostics company that has miniaturized the gold-standard PCR laboratory onto a single-use, palm-sized point-of-care device, delivering lab-quality results in about 30 minutes without any instrument, sample transport, or lab infrastructure. Its consumer offering (sold direct at visby.com) is an FDA-authorized at-home women's sexual health test that detects Chlamydia, Gonorrhea, and Trichomoniasis, paired with same-day telehealth consultation on a positive result. Visby also builds point-of-care PCR platforms for clinical and respiratory pathogen testing. The company is backed by venture investors including Amplify Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks Visby Medical as a company; the business is a hardware diagnostics and direct-to-consumer commerce operation and does not publish a first-party developer API, SDK, or developer portal at this time.

providers.name: WeiMai
providers.description: WeiMai (微脉) is a Chinese healthcare technology company operated by Choice Technology Inc. and headquartered in Hangzhou. It runs an internet-based medical services marketplace and licensed internet hospitals (including Hainan WeiMai Internet Hospital) that connect patients with doctors for online consultation, pharmaceutical products, medical devices, and health-management service packages, delivered primarily through the WeiMai consumer mobile app. WeiMai also operates a partner-facing Open Platform (微脉开发平台) at openapi.myweimai.com that exposes a Swagger 2.0 API surface for approved integrators; the public specification is a minimal stub with no operations exposed without partner credentials. The company is backed by IDG Capital and was added to the API Evangelist network as a healthcare portfolio company.

providers.name: AAVantgarde Bio
providers.description: AAVantgarde Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company headquartered in Milan, Italy, developing next-generation adeno-associated virus (AAV) gene therapies for inherited retinal diseases with high unmet need. Founded in 2021 by Prof. Alberto Auricchio, the company has built two proprietary vector platforms — dual hybrid and dual intein — that overcome the DNA cargo capacity limit of a single AAV vector by splitting a large expression cassette across two AAV8 vectors that recombine inside the target cell. Its lead programs are AAVB-081 for retinitis pigmentosa due to Usher syndrome type 1B (LUCE-1 Phase 1/2, the first dual AAV gene therapy tested clinically in an ocular indication) and AAVB-039 for ABCA4-associated Stargardt disease (CELESTE Phase 1/2), which holds FDA Fast Track and Orphan Drug designation. The company raised a EUR 61 million Series A and closed a USD 141 million Series B. AAVantgarde publishes no public API, developer program or machine-readable contract; this profile records what its public web surface actually serves.

providers.name: Fidocure
providers.description: FidoCure is a translational precision-medicine service for canine cancer, developed by One Health Company and backed by a16z. It combines next-generation genomic sequencing of a dog's tumor at a CLIA-certified (human-grade) lab with tumor profiling and an AI-driven data platform to identify cancer-driving mutations, then recommends personalized targeted therapeutics that veterinarians can prescribe. FidoCure has guided treatment for thousands of dogs across roughly 1,350 clinics and maintains the largest proprietary canine cancer dataset, underpinning peer-reviewed research with Stanford, the Broad Institute, Tufts, and the University of Georgia. FidoCure operates as a veterinarian-facing clinical service rather than a public developer API; this profile captures its public identity, portal, and domain-security posture for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Five Lives
providers.description: Five Lives is a health-technology company building evidence-based digital tools for dementia prevention and brain health for adults aged 50 and over. Founded by former Peak brain-training leaders Xavier Louis (CEO) and Sylvain Piquet (COO), the fully remote company operates two consumer mobile apps: Five Lives Brain Health, a prevention app available since 2021 with cognitive tests, brain games, and lifestyle tracking across five pillars (nutrition, sleep, physical activity, mood and social connection, and mental stimulation); and Five Lives Care, an evidence-based memory and autonomy programme for people aged 60+ launched in January 2026 and developed with leading memory centres in the UK and France. Its work draws on the FINGER study and the Lancet Commission's modifiable dementia risk factors, with research partners including the University of Oxford, Trinity College Dublin, the FINGER Brain Health Institute, Dementias Platform UK, and the Gerontopole d'Ile de France. Backed by Speedinvest. Five Lives does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: InFact
providers.description: InFact (InFact UK Ltd, trading as Infact — Solutions in public health) builds software for communicable-disease control and public-health service delivery. Founded in 2003 by Dr Chakib Kara-Zaitri and Bob Hamilton, the company's flagship product HPZone is an integrated suite for infectious-disease control built on two decades of frontline work with the national health services of the United Kingdom and the Netherlands: HPCore for case, contact and outbreak management with decision-support protocols and enquiry handling, EpiQ for epidemiological questionnaires, and HPInsight for surveillance dashboards, reporting and modelling. A second product line, Ampara (the successor to SHDirect), covers the clinic patient journey from triage through consultation, diagnostics, prescribing and follow-up. InFact is a Silver Industry Partner of openEHR International. HPZone exposes a credential-gated GraphQL API over cases, contacts, situations, enquiries, actions and contexts; the API exists and is in production use by national public-health bodies, but InFact publishes no public developer portal, reference or machine-readable contract.

providers.name: SAVA
providers.description: SAVA (sava.health) is a health-monitoring company developing a minimally invasive, continuous multi-molecule biosensor worn just beneath the skin. The platform is designed to capture real-time molecular data - glucose, lactate, ketones, sodium, histamine, urea, alcohol, and cortisol - and surface it through a connected mobile app, aiming to shift healthcare toward preventative monitoring and personal wellness. The company is early stage and pre-launch, operating a waiting-list model for early access to its device rather than a public product. It publishes no first-party developer API or health-data API; its marketing site is built on Wix and exposes the Wix Site MCP endpoint and a published llms.txt for agentic access to public site content only. Backed by Balderton Capital.

providers.name: Virgin Pulse
providers.description: Virgin Pulse is a corporate health and employee wellbeing platform that in 2024 merged with HealthComp and rebranded as Personify Health, operating today at personifyhealth.com. The company delivers a personalized health platform that unites wellbeing, healthcare navigation and advocacy, benefits administration, third-party administration (TPA), and rewards into a single employee experience for enterprises, health plans, and health systems. Integration with Personify Health is handled through an authentication-gated developer portal (developer.personifyhealth.com) and a partner marketplace (marketplace.personifyhealth.com); there is no publicly documented, open API specification. This profile was seeded as an Insight Partners portfolio lead and enriched from the company's live public surface (llms.txt, status page, developer portal, and DNS/TLS probes).

providers.name: Agebold
providers.description: Agebold, which operates as Bold, is a digital healthy-aging platform for adults 65 and older, delivered as a covered benefit through Medicare Advantage plans and other Medicare organizations. Bold offers personalized, science-backed exercise programs shown to reduce fall risk, ease musculoskeletal pain, and increase physical activity, alongside nutrition and weight-loss support (including GLP-1 care), live classes, expert talks, and virtual access to doctors, therapists, and nurse practitioners in select states. The company partners with health plans to improve quality measures, Star Ratings, HOS performance, and total cost of care. Agebold is a Khosla Ventures portfolio company; as of this profile it publishes no public API, developer portal, SDKs, or OpenAPI surface.

providers.name: Air Doctor
providers.description: Air Doctor is a digital health platform that connects travelers and people living abroad with a global network of vetted private doctors and specialists, offering in-person clinic visits, home visits, and telemedicine appointments in multiple languages across more than 75 countries. Users search for and book local doctors through the Air Doctor mobile app and web app, and the company operates a large B2B business embedding its provider network into travel insurance, assistance, and health-plan partners (including brands such as Allianz Global Assistance, ERGO, World Nomads, and Charles Taylor). Air Doctor is backed by Lightspeed Venture Partners. This API Evangelist profile tracks the company's public developer, partner, and web surface; Air Doctor does not publish a public API or developer portal at this time, so this profile is maintained as an identity and web-property record.

providers.name: Ash Wellness
providers.description: Ash Wellness provides at‑home health testing solutions for organizations, enabling health plans and public health entities to close care gaps with convenient, accurate diagnostics. Their platform offers a range of testing kits for infectious disease, cancer screening, chronic conditions, hormonal health, and environmental health, supported by a digital health integration and robust data reporting.

providers.name: Berry Street
providers.description: Berry Street is a telehealth platform that connects patients with board-certified, registered dietitians for virtual, insurance-covered nutrition therapy. Through 1-on-1 video sessions, patients receive medical nutrition therapy for 30+ conditions including eating disorders, diabetes, PCOS, IBS, gut health, heart disease, and prenatal and pediatric nutrition. Berry Street accepts 1,250+ insurance plans, matches patients to dietitians based on their needs, and offers an enterprise/employer offering for organizations. Backed by Northzone. This API Evangelist profile currently exposes no public developer or API surface; it is a company identity record enriched from Berry Street's public web presence.

providers.name: Courier Health
providers.description: Courier Health is the patient experience platform for life sciences and biopharma. It gives pharmaceutical patient services, market access, and field reimbursement teams a single command center to manage the patient journey from prescription through long-term treatment adherence, using AI-generated patient summaries, workflow automation and orchestration, and integration of data across systems and partners. The company reports gains in patient starts, six-month persistency, and team productivity, and delivers the product as a HIPAA-compliant, SOC 2 Type II SaaS platform. Courier Health is backed by Norwest Venture Partners. No public developer or API surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its published security/compliance posture.

providers.name: DeepScribe
providers.description: DeepScribe is a San Francisco, California ambient AI medical scribe company that automates clinical documentation and coding for specialty healthcare providers. Founded in 2017 (incorporated 2019) by Matthew Ko, Kairui Zeng, and Akilesh Bapu, DeepScribe captures the natural conversation between clinician and patient and produces structured clinical notes inside the provider's existing EHR workflow. The platform is HIPAA-compliant and is deployed across more than 1,500 healthcare organizations, with reported traction of 8 million+ visits captured and a 99.92% note-satisfaction rating. Core products include the AI Medical Scribe (ambient documentation), SmartPrep (pre-visit intelligence), AI Coding (E/M, ICD-10, and HCC automation), Customization Studio (provider-specific note personalization), and DeepScribe Assist (point-of-care insights). DeepScribe ships bi-directional EHR integrations with Epic, athenahealth, eClinicalWorks, NextGen, AdvancedMD, drchrono, ModMed, Flatiron (OncoEMR), Ontada (iKnowMed Generation 2), and Objective Medical Systems, with a focused practice in oncology, cardiology, gastroenterology, neurology, orthopedics, urology, and value-based care. The company partners with AWS, Anthropic, Deloitte, and Panda Health for infrastructure, model, and go-to-market support. DeepScribe is sold as enterprise SaaS through a contact-sales motion; there is no public developer API, SDK, or open-source release, and authentication into the clinician workspace happens through canvas.deepscribe.ai.

providers.name: Doctor on Demand
providers.description: Doctor on Demand is a telehealth platform offering 24/7 virtual medical care through video visits with board-certified clinicians. Services span urgent care, mental health therapy, psychiatry, primary care, and preventive health, with prescriptions routed to local pharmacies. Now part of Included Health, it serves consumers directly and through employer and health-plan benefit programs. It was surfaced as a portfolio company of a16z, GV, and Shasta Ventures. As of this enrichment pass Doctor on Demand publishes no public developer or partner API program; this profile carries the company identity and probed domain-security posture only.

providers.name: Getteal
providers.description: Getteal (Teal Health) is a women's health company offering an FDA-authorized at-home cervical cancer screening kit, the Teal Wand, a self-collection device that lets people collect a sample privately at home and mail it to a laboratory for Primary HPV testing (the same cobas HPV test used in clinics). The service pairs the device with virtual provider consultations, a patient portal for results, insurance and HSA/FSA billing, and support for major U.S. health plans. Getteal is backed by Felicis and surfaced in the API Evangelist network as a portfolio company; it is a consumer digital-health brand with no public developer program or API surface at this time.

providers.name: Grove Health
providers.description: Grove Health (Grove Medical Inc.) is a North American B2B healthcare supplies distributor operating an online catalog covering medical equipment and consumables, including nursing supplies, diagnostics, wound care, incontinence products, examination gloves, respiratory equipment, and related healthcare items. The company serves healthcare facilities and providers through a self-service e-commerce storefront. It has been backed by General Catalyst since 2021. No public API, developer program, or machine-readable interface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity and its public web surface.

providers.name: Hazel Health
providers.description: Hazel Health is the nation's leading provider of school-based telehealth, delivering virtual physical and mental health care to K-12 students. Founded in 2015 and headquartered in San Francisco, California, Hazel partners directly with school districts and families to connect students with licensed, linguistically and culturally diverse clinicians and therapists — at school or at home — often within minutes for medical care and within days for teletherapy, at no cost to families. The company serves more than two million students across 100-plus districts nationwide, helping reduce chronic absenteeism and address gaps in access to care as an extension of the school health team. Hazel operates HIPAA- and FERPA-compliant systems with full encryption and secure access controls. It is a B2B/B2G healthcare provider and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or developer portal.

providers.name: Ixlayer
providers.description: Ixlayer is a direct-to-patient healthcare technology company that helps biopharmaceutical companies transform the patient experience through an integrated, AI-enabled platform. Its unified platform spans virtual patient onboarding and intake, telehealth for primary and specialty care, at-home and in-center lab testing with mobile phlebotomy, prescription fulfillment (retail, specialty, and home delivery), benefits verification and claims, connected care with provider directories and scheduling, and the ixAI patient concierge for AI-powered support and care coordination. Ixlayer says it has powered more than 1,100 nationwide programs and enabled over 4 million patient care journeys, and states its services are SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, and GDPR compliant. The company is backed by General Catalyst.

providers.name: Meru Health
providers.description: Meru Health is a digital mental health company delivering a therapist-guided 12-week program for anxiety, depression, stress, and burnout. The platform blends licensed-therapist video sessions, an on-demand app of mindfulness and behavioral practices, an HRV biofeedback wearable, and anonymous peer support. Sold B2B2C to health plans and employers as a covered benefit, it is measurement-based and outcomes-focused. No public developer API, portal, SDK, or documentation surface was found during enrichment; this profile captures the company identity plus a probed domain-security posture.

providers.name: Nectar
providers.description: Nectar (Nectar Life Sciences) is a hybrid, vertically-integrated allergy care platform combining at-home testing with in-person clinical care. Patients can self-test for dozens of indoor and outdoor environmental allergens using mail-in home kits, then receive personalized treatment including sublingual immunotherapy (allergy drops), prescription nasal sprays, rescue inhalers, and allergy shots. Its flagship Nectar Allergy Center in New York City treats adults and children for environmental allergies, asthma, food allergies, and eczema, alongside virtual telehealth appointments. Nectar is a consumer healthcare provider with no public developer API surface; it was backed by Obvious Ventures, Juxtapose, and Harmony Partners.

providers.name: Pair Team
providers.description: Pair Team, PBC is a healthcare care-coordination company that pairs clinical care teams with technology to deliver comprehensive care management for underserved and vulnerable populations. It runs Enhanced Care Management for Medi-Cal (California Medicaid) members and a Medicare support program, coordinating housing assistance, food access, behavioral and mental health support, appointment scheduling, medication management, and transportation for people managing chronic conditions and social determinants of health. Its Flora AI care advocate helps triage and connect members to resources and escalates to clinical staff. Backed by Craft Ventures. Pair Team publishes no public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface at this time; this profile captures its company identity and public web properties.

providers.name: Revel Ai Health
providers.description: RevelAi Health is a healthcare technology company building a conversational AI platform for orthopedic and musculoskeletal care teams. Its AI agent, "kimi," automates patient outreach, triage, clinical documentation, and follow-up across the care episode, supporting value-based care models, quality reporting, and Patient-Reported Outcome Measures (PROM) collection. The platform offers multilingual population-health outreach across voice, text, and email, ambient clinical documentation, and AI-augmented staffing and task management for ambulatory surgery centers, hospitals and health systems, and physician practices. The company is a Techstars portfolio company and maintains SOC 2 Type II and HIPAA compliance programs. This profile was enriched by the API Evangelist pipeline; no public API surface was found.

providers.name: SteadyMD
providers.description: SteadyMD is a telehealth infrastructure and clinical-workforce company (a DocGo company) backed by Lux Capital. It supplies board-certified physicians and nurse practitioners, clinical operations, and 50-state licensing and credentialing, plus technology and telehealth APIs that let healthcare and digital-health partners launch branded, fully managed virtual care. Its APIs cover patient data submission, synchronous and asynchronous consult requests, two-way patient-clinician messaging, intake forms, clinician availability, real-time status updates, document attachments, scheduling, and reporting/SLA retrieval, offered as either a Limited (partner-EMR) or Complete (SteadyMD-EMR) integration. API documentation is provided under a business agreement via a request form; there is no public developer portal or OpenAPI at this time.

providers.name: Tend
providers.description: Tend (Tend Dental) is a consumer dental-care company offering modern, judgment-free dentistry through a network of design-forward "studios" across New York City, Boston, Atlanta, Washington DC, Nashville and Connecticut. The brand pairs a soothing in-person studio experience and top-rated dentists with a fully online booking and patient-intake flow at hellotend.com. Services span preventive hygiene, family dental care, cosmetic dentistry, veneers, Invisalign and clear aligners, orthodontics, dental implants, endodontics, sedation and emergency care. Backed by GV and Redpoint Ventures. This is a consumer web/ booking business with no public developer API surface; the profile is enriched with identity, security-posture and discovery-probe artifacts only.

providers.name: Tennr
providers.description: Tennr is a New York City-based healthcare technology company (founded 2021) building agentic patient-orchestration software that automates referral-based care operations for providers and health systems. Its proprietary vision-language model, RaeLM, is trained on over 100 million anonymized medical documents to read faxes, referrals, and unstructured records, then automates document classification, data extraction, patient qualification, insurance eligibility verification, and prior-authorization submission by integrating directly with existing EHR systems. Tennr processes over 10 million documents monthly and is HIPAA and SOC 2 compliant. It raised a $101M Series C at a $605M valuation led by IVP, with a16z, Lightspeed, GV, ICONIQ, and Foundation Capital participating. Tennr does not currently publish a public API, developer portal, or specification; integrations are delivered through EHR connections and professional services.

providers.name: Bioniq
providers.description: Bioniq is a personalized nutrition and supplement company founded in London in 2019 that combines individual biomarker and blood-test data with a proprietary algorithm to formulate customized vitamin and mineral blends delivered as Swiss-made granules. Its consumer product line spans Bioniq GO (wellness-assessment based), Bioniq PRO (blood-test driven), and Bioniq Essential, supported by iOS and Android apps for tracking health and supplement routines. Bioniq is a portfolio company of HV Capital and now operates within Herbalife. It exposes consumer web, mobile, and partner/affiliate surfaces but publishes no public developer API, SDK, or API documentation as of this enrichment pass.

providers.name: Capim
