Through its web and mobile applications the company matches members with licensed therapists trained in Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) therapy, delivers live video sessions, and provides between-session messaging, a peer community, and in-app therapeutic tools. NOCD is in-network with a large number of US health plans and serves children, adolescents, and adults. The product is delivered as an end-user clinical service — the company operates a private mobile/web application backend at api.treatmyocd.com but publishes no public developer program, API reference, or machine-readable specification.

providers.name: Plenful
providers.description: Plenful is an AI-powered workflow automation platform for pharmacy and healthcare operations, founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco with an office in New York City. The platform automates complex, high-ROI administrative pharmacy workflows — 340B audit and optimization, 340B referral capture, rebate and Maximum Fair Price (MFP) reconciliation, benefits verification and prior authorization, and infusion order intake — using large language models and machine learning tuned to each organization's data. It ingests PDFs, flat files, APIs, HL7 feeds, and databases, supports unlimited organizational logic rules, and serves 100+ healthcare organizations including Prisma Health, Renown Health, Temple Health, Cencora, and Samaritan Health Services. Plenful is backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, Notable Capital (formerly GGV Capital), SUSA Ventures, TQ Ventures, and Waterline Ventures. Plenful ships an enterprise SaaS product and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDK, or documentation surface.

providers.name: Prosper Health
providers.description: Prosper Health is a telehealth provider focused exclusively on autistic and neurodivergent adults, offering virtual autism diagnostic assessments and ongoing affirming, strength-based therapy delivered by licensed psychologists and therapists who specialize in adult autism. Its adult-validated, telehealth-native assessment (an alternative to the child-oriented ADOS) runs entirely online across two psychologist sessions plus a feedback session, with results reported within roughly two weeks. Prosper Health accepts major insurers (Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Oscar, Oxford, United) across 20-plus US states. It is a direct-to-consumer clinical care company with no public developer API surface; this profile tracks its web, security, and identity properties for the API Evangelist network.

providers.name: Ro
providers.description: Ro (ro.co) is a direct-to-consumer telehealth company that connects patients with US-licensed healthcare providers entirely online, offering prescription treatment, provider visits, and pharmacy fulfillment across categories including men's and women's health, weight management (Ro Body), dermatology (Ro Derm), hair loss, fertility (Ro Fertility), and sexual health. Ro deliberately operates a "Zero-API" vertically integrated online-visit experience and does not publish a public developer API, SDKs, or a developer portal; its only public machine-readable surface is a security posture (RFC 9116 security.txt and a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure program). Ro is backed by Canaan Partners, General Catalyst, and Initialized Capital.

providers.name: Vocca Ai
providers.description: Vocca is a healthcare voice-AI company (backed by Speedinvest) that builds AI voice and text agents acting as a 24/7 receptionist for medical groups and practices. Vocca handles inbound and outbound patient calls, appointment bookings, reminders, and follow-ups across specialties including imaging, dental, cardiology, gynecology, ophthalmology, anesthesiology, general medicine, hospitals, and multi-practice clinics, so clinical teams spend less time on admin and more time on care. The company operates a customer-facing product with French and English coverage; it does not publish a public developer portal, API reference, or machine-readable API specification, so this profile carries company identity and website link-properties only.

providers.name: Besoundbreast
providers.description: BeSound (Besoundbreast) is a women's-health technology platform offering modern, radiation-free breast imaging using ABUS ultrasound to help find cancers that mammograms can miss, particularly in women with dense breast tissue. BeSound connects patients with independent partner medical groups who deliver the imaging; results reach a secure patient portal within 24-48 weekday hours. Screening breast ultrasound is $349, with locations in Los Angeles (Melrose Ave) and Beverly Hills. BeSound is a consumer healthcare service and does not currently publish a public developer API, SDKs, or developer portal; this profile captures its public identity and the machine-readable llms.txt it publishes for AI agents.

providers.name: Botco.ai
providers.description: Botco.ai provides generative AI chatbot solutions that augment workforce productivity across industries such as healthcare, city services, and pharmaceuticals. Their platform enables organizations to automate compliance, streamline navigation, and scale operations with AI agents, offering customizable chat experiences, integrations, and analytics. Founded to empower teams with conversational AI, Botco.ai delivers enterprise-grade chatbot technology and consulting services to drive efficiency and innovation.
